jobs.prompt: Bug (parts-app): autopilot launched a stale, already-superseded manifest (a database test fix that had been rerun by hand earlier) as a NEW run. The cause is the manifest-based start actions in tools/autopilot.mjs (start-wave from the plan file waves, start-deferred, start-backlog), which decide only from this autopilot's own journal events, so a wave that was already run by hand, or superseded, looks unstarted. Owner rule: autopilot must start ONLY ready ledger tickets (the start-ready action, which runs go --scope) and must never run loose manifests from the coordination folder or the plan file. Fix: (1) the default set of actions becomes: integrate, resume, retry-failed, unlock-tickets and start-ready; the manifest-based actions start-wave, start-deferred and start-backlog run ONLY when the caller opts in with an option legacyPlan (runAutopilot option; CLI flag --legacy-plan on swarm autopilot, parsed in tools/swarm.mjs where the autopilot command options are read, documented in the command usage text), and the opt-in is never set by a default invocation. (2) Even with legacyPlan, a wave or goal is skipped (one journal record with reason already-run, and a result entry) when a run already exists for it: compare the wave manifest's job ids and outputs hash with the saved runs (any run, started by anyone, whose manifest has the same job ids and whose status is complete or integrated, or whose jobs all completed) and when the wave's job ids all appear as complete in an existing run; also skip when the manifest file is older than the newest run that contains any of its job ids. (3) The retry-failed and resume actions only act on runs that autopilot's own pass lists as active for this project (unchanged) but must never create a run from a manifest file in the coordination folder: if any code path starts a run from a manifest path, route it through the same legacyPlan check. (4) The 'integrate' action never applies to a run that is review-only (integrable false): that is already handled in this branch. Tests in tests/autopilot-ledger-only.test.mjs (node:test, strict assert, fakes like tests/autopilot.test.mjs): default autopilot with a plan wave whose dependencies are complete and no ledger tickets does NOT start the wave (no start-wave action); with ready ledger tickets it starts only start-ready; with legacyPlan true it starts a wave that no run covers; with legacyPlan true a wave whose job ids already completed in an earlier run (rerun by hand) is skipped with reason already-run; a stale manifest older than the newest run containing its jobs is skipped; the CLI flag is parsed (legacy-plan on, absent off) and the usage text mentions it; start-backlog and start-deferred do not run by default; plus one test that a complete review-only ask run in the same pass raises no blocker and starts nothing. Update existing autopilot tests only where they relied on start-wave running by default (pass legacyPlan: true there). Write only tools/autopilot.mjs, tools/swarm.mjs, tests/autopilot-ledger-only.test.mjs and the existing autopilot test files that must opt in.
